scripts.typecheck: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck:browser && npm run typecheck:tooling
scripts.tokens:verify: npm run tokens:validate && npm run tokens:build && npm run tokens:generated:check && npm run tokens:audit:strict
scripts.build:runtime: npm run tokens:build && npm run compile:browser && node .build/tooling/scripts/sync-runtime.js
scripts.validate: npm run build:runtime && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-source-boundary.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-overrides.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-production-boundary.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-responsive-contract.js
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run tokens:verify && npm run validate && npm run build:pages
